name: outlook
description: Read, send and reply to Outlook mail; read and manage Microsoft 365 calendar events

io.github.personaljarvis.post_install_hint_md: Create your own Microsoft Entra public/native application with redirect URI http://127.0.0.1:43891/oauth/callback, then enter its client ID in this dialog. Enable personal and work/school accounts when supported; no client secret is needed for a public app. Grant only the delegated permissions listed below. Tenant policies may require administrator consent. Each plugin is connected separately and shares only your app registration.  Permissions: offline_access, User.Read, Mail.Read, Mail.Send, Calendars.ReadWrite.
